gloss: dead battery; battery drained; out of power

definitions.gloss: dead battery; battery drained; out of power
definitions.explanation: The state of a battery being completely depleted, causing a device to stop functioning.

examples.japanese: スマホが{電池切|でんちぎ}れになった。
{電池切|でんちぎ}れで{連絡|れんらく}できなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't contact you because my battery was dead.

examples.japanese: {電池切|でんちぎ}れを{防|ふせ}ぐためにモバイルバッテリーを{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている。
examples.english: I carry a portable charger to prevent my battery from dying.

notes:
{電池切|でんちぎ}れ describes the state of a battery being completely drained. Extremely common in daily life with smartphones and other devices.

FORMS:
{電池|でんち} (battery) + {切|き}れ (running out, from {切|き}れる).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {電池切|でんちぎ}れになる: the battery dies
- {電池切|でんちぎ}れで{連絡|れんらく}できない: can't contact because battery is dead
- {電池切|でんちぎ}れを{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent battery drain

SIMILAR ～{切|ぎ}れ EXPRESSIONS:
- バッテリー{切|ぎ}れ: battery dead (katakana variant)
- {充電|じゅうでん}{切|ぎ}れ: out of charge
- ガス{切|ぎ}れ: out of gas
- {品切|しなぎ}れ: out of stock

RELATED WORDS:
- {充電|じゅうでん}: charging
- {充電器|じゅうでんき}: charger
- モバイルバッテリー: portable charger/power bank

The ～{切|ぎ}れ pattern (from {切|き}れる, to run out) is productive for expressing depletion of any resource.
